programme.title: Tomato Episode with Chef Natalia Machado
programme.desc: Join our host, Chef Natalia Machado as she introduces us to her favourite techniques for using a wide variety of versatile, savoury tomatoes.

programme.title: Duck Episode with Chef Craig Wong
programme.desc: Chef-host Craig Wong is our duck sherpa in this well-travelled episode of Cook Like a Chef"... first stop? Peking Duck!

programme.title: Potato Episode with Chef Derek Dammann
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Derek Dammann demonstrates talent and skills in demystifying the potato, using tons of terrific techniques"...

programme.title: Fried Rice
programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: Fennel Orange Salad
programme.desc: Host Tiera Singh gets the show on the road with her Italian- inspired Fennel Orange Salad. Seared sushi-grade tuna rests on top of a crunchy, zesty, tangy fennel and orange salad with a honey-vinegar dressing to sweeten it up! Micah Trainor's revamp? Five Spice Duck a L'Orange with a sugary caramelized orange sauce and duck fat fried potatoes - is it French? Chinese? Who knows, but it's delicious! Next, Poppy Sandler pulls off a vegetarian variation, with a Roasted Veggie Bouillabaisse, complete with musky morels, umami-packed kombu, and tender asparagus. Missy Hui finishes up with her Orange Licorice Panna Cotta - aromatic orange blossom honey and licorice-like fennel pollen make the dish a decadent denouement to this episode of Up the Dish!

programme.title: Portugal, Argentina, India, Japan
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo creates veggie dishes inspired by Portugal, Argentina, India, and Japan!

programme.title: Indian Classics
programme.desc: Ever crave a delicious Indian feast? Host Vijaya Selvaraju cooks up Indian classics for a delightful family meal.

programme.title: Papaya Salad, Carrot Hog Dogs, Squid, and Tofu
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford unveils four spellbinding dishes! First up, green papaya salad with crispy pork! Next, BBQ carrot hot dogs! Followed by grilled squid steak! Finishing with Korean BBQ tofu!

programme.title: Summer
programme.desc: Nothing screams summer more than salsa, especially chef Pino's sunshine yellow salsa served with grilled halloumi cheese. Yes, please! Next up, snappy snow peas pair with summer strawberries in a sprouted quinoa salad with Champagne vinaigrette! Pino then takes summer sunbathing to the next level, serving up blistered Shishito peppers and buttery radishes with sesame seeds and edible seaweed! For his final dish, Pino sums up summer with a French-style ratatouille served as a salad! Thinly sliced vegetables are lightly marinated before pairing with a fresh carrot purée in a dish that sparkles with summer.

programme.title: Weeknight Dishes made in Little Thyme
programme.desc: Who has "thyme" to make dinner after a hectic day? Host Vanessa Gianfrancesco inspires with four recipes including a Mushroom Thyme Risotto.

programme.title: French Onion Soup
programme.desc: Onions, cheese, bread, soup, four elements that live in harmony, especially in this episode of Up the Dish! Poppy Sandler starts off in Paris - classic French Onion Soup with sweet, caramelized onions and melty Comte cheese, with perfect rounds of toasted baguette. Poppy passes it over to Micah Trainor, who doesn't miss a beat; her Tenderloin Roast with Sherry Braised Shallots is sweet, savoury, and bursting with flavour. Tiera Singh takes a chive-y dive into the vegetarian side with her Chive Pesto Pasta - don't worry, the pesto is totally customizable! Missy Hui has the showstopper, Scallion Ash Carrots and Parsnips, and it's a five-star treatment that takes the simple to spectacular! Sous-vide carrots and turnips are sprinkled with sweet-savoury scallion ash for a strangely satisfying dish.

programme.title: White Fish Episode with Chef Katie Ardington
programme.desc: Skilled Chef Katie Ardington is excited to introduce her favourite fish, striped sea bass, in this fabulous voyage through the 7 seas of seafood cookery.

programme.title: Chicken Episode with Chef Natalia Machado
programme.desc: Chef-host Natalia Machado loves chicken, and who doesn't? Chicken is enjoyed around the world for good reason; it is versatile and reliably delicious!

programme.title: Salad Episode with Chef Craig Wong
programme.desc: Salad is a wonderful addition to any meal, and sometimes even a meal on its own"... today, the talented Chef Craig Wong shares several of his superior salad ideas.

programme.title: Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

He starts with aromatic Moroccan lamb riblets, an appetizer that will make you want this spicy dish as your main course too. He brings coconut oil, brown sugar, creamed coconut, and molasses to boil before skillfully adding flour and anise to make sweet, chewy coconut licorice. Finally, Robert concocts the perfect recipe that combines succulent lamb with sweet licorice.

programme.title: Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: No One Lives
programme.desc: A gang of ruthless highway killers kidnap a wealthy couple traveling cross country only to shockingly discover that things are not what they seem.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: The Legion [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: The Coca Cola Kid
programme.desc: A smug sales executive treks to Australia to improve regional sales and becomes embroiled in sexual and professional shenanigans.

programme.title: Tim
programme.desc: A somewhat mentally handicapped 20-year-old man works as a laborer, but everyone abuses his naivety. A nice 40-year-old American woman hires him one day and they become close. However, the town and his family see her as predatory.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: A South African gold mine foreman is unwittingly manipulated by an unscrupulous gang of financiers who want to flood the mine to raise the price of gold on the world market.

programme.title: Vanishing Bride
programme.desc: Lisa and Lawrence have big plans for their future, but everything is ruined when Lisa vanishes. An investigation reveals a jealous ex, a threatening soldier, and a betrayal.

programme.title: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations- The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which as mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid the box exploded killing her instantly. Within minutes, five other bombs exploded proving to be as fatal as the first. The investigation into this serial bombing case became one of the most massive investigations in history.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: During December of 1999, public health authorities in Alberta, Canada are notified of two cases of a rare form of bacterial meningitis. A third reported case claims the life of a seventeen-year-old. Soon after, six more cases are reported and another young life is taken. Health officials think a new strain of the bacteria may be invading the population. The Provincial Laboratory discovers that a new genetic strain has indeed been introduced, but luckily, the meningitis vaccine that exists will still work against it. The Public Health Authority must act quickly to vaccinate and immunize over 50,000 young people before the bacteria claims any more victims.

programme.title: Death Grip
programme.desc: Fingerprinting- The identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals. Fingerprints, along with palmprints and footprints are an indisputable, time-tested method to establish someone’s ID beyond a shadow of a doubt. Computerization has all but eliminated the old inkpad, and print identification that used to take months now takes minutes.

programme.title: Toxic Exposure
programme.desc: In December of 1979, a young girl passes out on a bus in Wisconsin. She is taken to the hospital complaining of a sore throat, fever and aching muscles. Doctors believe she has the flu, until her blood pressure drops and her kidneys begin to fail. When additional women begin exhibiting similar symptoms, which bring them close to death, doctors fear an outbreak of toxic shock syndrome. The CDC and local health officials are alerted, triggering and intense investigation. After nearly one year, officials determine the cause of the outbreak, which has already killed seven.

programme.title: Shattered Sisterhood
programme.desc: Sandy is shot two days before her wedding to Dave. The consequent investigation reveals an ex, and a mystery woman were involved, and not a botched robbery as first suspected.

programme.title: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis- We’ve all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder? While our handwriting may not reveal the nuances of our personalities, the dotting of the 'i’s and crossing of the 't's is an important business in criminal investigation. Apparent suicide notes, letters from suspected offenders and signatures are scrutinized down to the last dot. Handwriting comparisons can tell if the victim really did sign that new life insurance policy, or if the person who had everything to live for actually wrote the eloquent suicide note.

programme.title: Deadly Spores
programme.desc: Canadian doctors are alarmed when a middle-aged woman dies of cryptococcal meningitis in 1999. Over the next few years, doctors see dozens of similar infections with pneumonia-like symptoms including shortness of breath, weight loss and severe headaches. Vancouver Island becomes home to the largest outbreak of the deadly fungus anywhere in the world. Local veterinarians report dozens of cases in the animal population, raising fears that the reach of the deadly fungus is not limited to any one species. DNA typing reveals that this new form of cryptococcus is identical to a strain normally found in Australia, leaving doctors with more questions than answers.

programme.desc: Cupid's arrow hits the mark with Bruce and his gal Janice. But during a three-month anniversary hunting trip, a bullet shatters their union. But who fired it?

programme.title: Dangerous Contact
programme.desc: In 1993, aquatic researcher Joanne Burkholder suffers an array of troubling symptoms while working in her North Carolina State University lab. A fellow researcher confides that he has recently been plagued by bizarre medical problems including memory loss, confusion, numbness and a burning sensation on the skin, symptoms identical to Burkholder’s. One night Glasgow accidentally splashes aquarium water on his arm. Within minutes, lesions appear on his skin. A neurologist determines that the scientists’ symptoms are somehow related to their work with Pfiesteria, a single celled organism linked to increased fish kills in local rivers.

A fellow researcher confides that he has recently been plagued by bizarre medical problems including memory loss, confusion, numbness and a burning sensation on the skin, symptoms identical to Burkholder’s. One night Glasgow accidentally splashes aquarium water on his arm. Within minutes, lesions appear on his skin. A neurologist determines that the scientists’ symptoms are somehow related to their work with Pfiesteria, a single celled organism linked to increased fish kills in local rivers.

programme.title: Flash Eater
programme.desc: When an unpredictable germ terrifies Texas in 1998, the CDC and health officials alert all neighboring states and territories to be on the lookout for streptococcus outbreak, the same bacteria that causes strep throat. This new strain, however, will kill 33 people, causing flesh-eating viruses, introducing deadly toxins into the blood and introducing pneumonia. Before the bacteria is contained, physicians from the United States and Canada will have to work together to fight the deadly strain.

programme.title: The Rolling Rice Ball
programme.desc: WI-Go drops one of his rice balls in a rat hole and gets a handful of jewelry in return. Meanwhile, a greedy neighbor next door UGo hears the news.

programme.title: Stone Soup
programme.desc: WI-Go the traveler is starving and has nothing but his brain. He ends up making the most delicious soup in the world using a mysterious stone without using a single penny.

programme.title: Heungboo and Nolboo
programme.desc: Mischievous UGo takes all of his parents' property and kicks his younger brother GoGo out of the house. Meanwhile, a swallow bird brings a gourd seed to the eaves of a kind-hearted GoGo house, and soon, gourds containing gold and silver treasures opens on the roof of the GoGo's house.

programme.title: The Star Talers
programme.desc: In the cold winter, the kindhearted girl, GoGo, meets several people who feel sorry for her on her way home. A fairy queen appears in front of a GoGGo that distributes all her clothes and bread and shakes in the cold.

programme.title: Wake Up and Smell the Bathtub
programme.desc: Maple avoids taking a bath but in the Zooniverse she helps the Zoonicorns restore their unique scents after they are blown away. She learns the importance of cleanliness and caring for herself.

programme.title: I Can't Heeeear You
programme.desc: Pancake finds the Zoonicorns have lost their voices. He must learn to understand visual clues to help them. Through this he discovers new ways of communication and problem solving.

programme.title: The Tickle Tree Talks
programme.desc: Pancake and the Zoonicorns try to cheer up a sad Tickle Tree. They learn that sometimes simply listening and being present is enough to help a friend feel better.

programme.title: Wapiti's Wheely Good Waka
programme.desc: While preparing their waka for summer Darwin and Newts meet Wapiti using a wheelchair. They work together to make the waka accessible and learn about inclusion.

programme.title: KiwiFruit Valley Christmas
programme.desc: A storm ruins Christmas plans but Darwin Newts and Heni work together. They create a simple celebration and learn that friendship and care matter more than perfection.

programme.title: Banzai as a Kite
programme.desc: While flying kites Gummy builds an advanced one that lifts him into the air. With help from Harry gadgets it goes out of control and the group must act quickly to bring him safely back down.

programme.title: Hairy Harry
programme.desc: Harry suffers from dry skin and seeks help but receives a hair product instead. His hair grows wildly causing chaos and fun as the others enjoy it until Harry finds a way to fix the situation.

programme.title: The Return of the Alien
programme.desc: While using a laser Gummy accidentally triggers an alien event and goes on a wild ride. The experience teaches the group important lessons about responsibility and not misusing gadgets.

programme.desc: Braianna tries to avoid taking her embarrassing Fake Robot Dad to the Father Daughter Dance.

programme.title: Spaced Out
programme.desc: The Jungle's are sucked into the space by an alien species that loves cricket. They team up with the extra -terrestrials for a fantastic game and emerge victorious. A truly out-of-this-world tale.

programme.title: Tales of Siva -2
programme.desc: On a lively Sunday, mischievous Kuttu and Chutti persuade their praying grandma to share enchanting tales of Lord Siva, turning their day into a journey of myth and devotion.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E53
programme.desc: Acudiendo al llamado de Israel, Clara Inés y Raúl se tensan al desconocer de qué verdad el hombre les quiere hablar.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E002
programme.desc: Victoria que está desnuda explica a Pablo (Nicolás) por qué se quedó sin ropa; el joven le da su camisa para que pueda salir del río. Hilario aprovecha cualquier oportunidad para galantear a Florencia. Por órdenes de Hilario, Zambrano a compaña a Pablo y Felipe en la cacería, pues debe vigilarlos. Victoria reta a Pablo a demostrar su puntería; él quiere como premio un beso de ella. Rosendo asegura a Florencia que a Hilario Guanipa a veces es mejor tenerlo lejos.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E003
programme.desc: Hilario advierte a Victoria que no confía en Pablo porque presiente que el joven oculta algo. Ante una indiscreción de Felipe; a Pablo no le queda más remedio que revelarle a Hansen que él es Nicolás Del Casal. Nicolás está decidido a vengarse de Hilario Guanipa por haber matado a su padre. Victoria lee una nota que le dejara Pablo (Nicolás) asegurándole que volverán a verse y pidiéndole que lo espere.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E100
programme.desc: Celso desquiciado veja y se burla de Fausto, éste dispara al pecho del amante que cae al instante. Fausto va hacia su oficina, diciendo a todos que no ha pasado nada. Camila, en el lugar de los hechos, trata de convencer a Patricia que huya pues todo indica que ella es la asesina de Celso.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E101
programme.desc: Patricia, llora, negando haber matado a Celso. Fausto manipula a sus hijos para convencerlos de que su madre es la asesina y debe entregarse. Camila declara muy elocuente su versión de los hechos, y luego cuenta a Ezequiel que mintió para hacer pagar a Patricia por un delito que no cometió, tal cual se lo hicieron a su madre.

programme.title: Abigail - S03:E030 - Episode 30
programme.desc: María Begoña sin piedad le pregunta a su gemela si sigue enamorada de Carlos Fernando. Mariana desgarrada le suplica a su madre que le cuente toda la verdad a su padre. Abigail está desconsolada con el desprecio de Carlos Alfredo.

programme.title: Abigail - S03:E031 - Episode 31
programme.desc: María Begoña amenaza de muerte a Lucía. Bárbara antes de irse del país hace su último intento por conseguir el perdón de Abigail. Bertha sigue con actitud despectiva hacia Rosalba. Abigail le dice a Carlos Alfredo que su hijo vive.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E118
programme.desc: Omar y su Jefe exigen hacer la reconstrucción de los hechos - Patricia habla con Lorena y le pide que le dé una nueva oportunidad a Alberto, pues sabe que ellos aún se aman - Claudio narra la supuesta forma en que sucedieron las cosas, el día de la muerte de Paco; pero Norma no aguanta más tanta falsedad e interrumpe la reconstrucción gritando que todo lo que Claudio dijo es una gran mentira.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E119
programme.desc: María Lourdes comparece ante el Juez Echeverri y se entrega por el delito de corrupción y aceptar sobornos de Gertrudis; entrega una carpeta con documentos que prueban lo que dice para hundir a la señora Corona con ella - Gertrudis se burla de las acusaciones de Alberto y niega, una vez más, ser una asesina. Alberto se va a la biblioteca, no puede vivir sabiendo lo que su madre hizo y no es capaz de aceptar. Se escucha un disparo y todo parece indicar que Alberto se suicidó. Lorena, enardecida, culpa a Gertrudis de lo sucedido y el Jefe corrobora la muerte de su hijo. Gertrudis cae de rodillas, destrozada, gritando como fiera herida.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E120
programme.desc: Alberto llega al parque donde está Lorena con Norma e Ignacio. A él le parece que ya es tiempo del perdón y le cuenta lo que hizo con Claudio y Gertrudis, siguiendo el consejo que ella misma le dio; ahora se siente aliviado y listo para continuar. Alberto, arrodillado ante ella, le propone matrimonio a Lorena con un anillo en sus manos. Ella acepta feliz. "El que perdona la ofensa, cultiva el amor…" Fin.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E004
programme.desc: Hilario no entiende el sentimiento de soledad de Adelaida. Nicolás y Felipe conocen a Liliana, quien evidencia su atracción por Del Casal de inmediato. Moncho le deja saber a Florencia que gusta de ella. Liliana anuncia a Antonieta que está decidida a conquistar a Nicolás.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E005
programme.desc: Victoria no asiste a la cita que le hiciera Rosendo. Nicolás y Liliana se besan con pasión cuando se activa accidentalmente el celular del joven y la voz de Victoria interrumpe el momento. Adelaida sorprende a Hilario besando a la fuerza a Florencia. Rosendo trata de sobrepasarse con Victoria, pero ella logra huir. Adelaida anuncia a Victoria e Hilario que decidió mandar a su hija a vivir a la capital.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E102
programme.desc: Camila para hacer vivir a Patricia la misma angustia que debió sentir su madre; le ofrecerá ayuda y luego la expondrá públicamente. Camila, posee el video grabado de lo ocurrido con Celso y la condición para no entregarlo a la policía es que Fausto cuente cómo fue que incriminaron a su mamá.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E01
programme.desc: Lorena y Guillermo discuten en lo que parece ser su rutina diaria. En la trastienda de un anticuario, Claudio Corona contrata a un Mafioso para que mate a su hermano Marco Aurelio y poder tomar posesión de sus bienes. Lorena se entera que su marido es un sicario. Para recuperar a su hijo secuestrado, Lorena debe de cometer un crimen.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E02
programme.desc: Guillermo le dice a Lorena que si no mata a Marco Aurelio Corona, no volverá a ver a su hijo. Lorena regresa con Lucas y le informa que no pudo asesinarlo. Por designios del destino Lorena y Alberto se vuelven a ver. Alberto se impacta al reconocer a Lorena y se pregunta como terminó siendo ella precisamente la enfermera personal de su padre.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E92 - Superpredators
programme.desc: For thousands—or even millions—of years, they ruled the food chain. And they still fascinate us. Creatures synonymous with the hunt: Saber Teeth, Mega Jaws, even a Tyrant King. How did they win evolution’s race—and what brought their reign to an end?

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E49 - Flight of the Dragon Mission Update
programme.desc: Witness this historic flight, from the first manned launch from the US in nearly a decade to the first splashdown attempt since the Apollo era.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E69 - Voyage to Venus
programme.desc: For the first time in decades, NASA is sending two new missions to Venus designed to study and explore the planet’s atmosphere and earth-like composition. Together, DAVINCI and VERITAS will provide a new, 360º view of Venus -- its history, and perhaps a window into Earth’s past as well.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E75 - Artemis First Launch
programme.desc: This is an inside look at NASA's groundbreaking Artemis Program, the spacecraft, and the people who will bring humanity one step closer to the moon, Mars, and beyond.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E94 - Artemis II Ready for the Moon
programme.desc: Explore the rockets, landers, vehicles, and space capsule paving the way for future Artemis missions to the lunar surface. And meet the engineers—and the machines—behind NASA's Commercial Lander Payload Services (CLPS) missions, which are revolutionizing humanity’s relationship with the Moon.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E08 - First Light
programme.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther – carrying us ever closer to the first light that ever bathed the Universe in which we live.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E09 - Stars Above
programme.desc: Stars are a bit like human beings. They can be warm or cold, they come in all kinds of shapes and sizes... and, let’s face it, they can be dim or bright. And recent discoveries suggest that the number of stars in our galaxy alone, the Milky Way, may exceed 200 billion. Just what are these citizens of the night sky?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E10 - The Dark Side
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it’s little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E01 - Living with Space
programme.desc: How do astronauts cope with living in space? The unique environment, the lack of taste in their food and the smell of canned air all contribute to the stresses of living and working in space.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E02 - Atmosphere
programme.desc: Climate change and pollution are having dire consequences for the atmosphere of our planet, this episode updates the latest technology and science looking into the health of our air.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E03 - Flight Status
programme.desc: The latest updates on The New space hardware about to launch us into the next generation of space flight some rockets and capsules are on time others not so fortunate.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E39 - Worlds Best Dinosaur Fossil
programme.desc: An extraordinary new discovery of a dinosaur fossil so pristine and complete, that it shows off the texture, patterns, and color of a prehistoric giant. Discover this brand new species that roamed during the late Jurassic and Cretaceous periods.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E03 - Bear In Focus
programme.desc: A group of conservationists are observing a family of black bears in the wooded hills of Oklahoma, and Ivan gets to meet them.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E04 - Aggressive Measures
programme.desc: Ivan goes to Mozambique to join an anti-poaching team that focuses on catching poachers and protecting at-risk animals.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E01 - Sinking Cities
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. In this episode, travel with scientists from the Earth Observatory of Singapore across the region to understand what is causing cities to sink, how they are being monitored, and why building resilience into communities is critical to their long-term survival.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E02 - Extreme Weather, Powerful Tsunamis
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. For scientists at the Earth Observatory of Singapore, it is a race against time to understand the effects climate change will have on coastal infrastructures in the region, ports, and trade. Just how prepared are we, for extreme weather events in the future?

programme.title: Underwater Wonders - S01:E01 - Part One
programme.desc: The US National Parks have some of the most iconic landscapes in the U.S. But there is also an underwater side to explore! Today we explore the USS Arizona and the marine environment which formed around it. Later, we journey into the underwater world of Yellowstone National Park.

programme.title: Underwater Wonders - S01:E02 - Part Two
programme.desc: The US National Parks have some of the most iconic landscapes in the U.S. But there is also an underwater side to explore! Today we dive into the cave systems of Death Valley National Park, journey to Montezuma Well, search for shipwrecks in Buck Island, and explore Lake Mead.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E09 - Naturally Invigorating
programme.desc: Iceland: home to volcanic lakes and hot springs and mono-chromatic vistas. And then to Laos in South East Asia with its lush jungles, underground caves and water buffalo along the Mekong River.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E01 - Naturally Wild
programme.desc: Many islands lie in the sea between Great Britain and Scandinavia. All of these islands would have remaind snow-covered and life would not have been sustainable were it not for the Gulf Stream. The warm waters flowing through the Atlantic Ocean all the way to South America account for the mild island climate, rich nature and history that reaches back thousands of years. Such are the three islands we are about to visit in today’s Miracles of Nature – Vesterålen, the Fair Isle and the Orkneys.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble
programme.desc: Zimbabwe was initially Southern Rhodesia and lies to the south of the Victoria Falls along the river Zambezi. Zambia was initially Northern Rhodesia and lies on the other bank of the river. Zimbabwe is a landlocked country in the south-east of Africa. It borders with South Africa to the south. According to archaeologists, the earliest records indicate that first human settlements in this area reach back to the 3rd century.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E03 - Naturally Sustaining
programme.desc: We journey in search of incredible miracles of nature begins on the Canary Islands. Lanzarote is of a volcanic origin. Volcanic activity created a fantastical landscape, similar to that on Mars. On Gran Canarias we will witness a traditional harvest of a crop that has been brought to the rest of the world from here - sugarcane. We will wrap up this episode in the Moroccan province of Gulemin, a home to a nomadic tribe whose inseparable companions are camels.

For scientists at the Earth Observatory of Singapore, it is a race against time to understand the effects climate change will have on coastal infrastructures in the region, ports, and trade. Just how prepared are we, for extreme weather events in the future?

programme.title: Underwater Wonders - S01:E01 - Part One
programme.desc: The US National Parks have some of the most iconic landscapes in the U.S. But there is also an underwater side to explore! Today we explore the USS Arizona and the marine environment which formed around it. Later, we journey into the underwater world of Yellowstone National Park.

programme.title: Underwater Wonders - S01:E02 - Part Two
programme.desc: The US National Parks have some of the most iconic landscapes in the U.S. But there is also an underwater side to explore! Today we dive into the cave systems of Death Valley National Park, journey to Montezuma Well, search for shipwrecks in Buck Island, and explore Lake Mead.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E09 - Naturally Invigorating
programme.desc: Iceland: home to volcanic lakes and hot springs and mono-chromatic vistas. And then to Laos in South East Asia with its lush jungles, underground caves and water buffalo along the Mekong River.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E01 - Naturally Wild
programme.desc: Many islands lie in the sea between Great Britain and Scandinavia. All of these islands would have remaind snow-covered and life would not have been sustainable were it not for the Gulf Stream. The warm waters flowing through the Atlantic Ocean all the way to South America account for the mild island climate, rich nature and history that reaches back thousands of years. Such are the three islands we are about to visit in today’s Miracles of Nature – Vesterålen, the Fair Isle and the Orkneys.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E02- Naturally Noble
programme.desc: Zimbabwe was initially Southern Rhodesia and lies to the south of the Victoria Falls along the river Zambezi. Zambia was initially Northern Rhodesia and lies on the other bank of the river. Zimbabwe is a landlocked country in the south-east of Africa. It borders with South Africa to the south. According to archaeologists, the earliest records indicate that first human settlements in this area reach back to the 3rd century.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E03 - Naturally Sustaining
programme.desc: We journey in search of incredible miracles of nature begins on the Canary Islands. Lanzarote is of a volcanic origin. Volcanic activity created a fantastical landscape, similar to that on Mars. On Gran Canarias we will witness a traditional harvest of a crop that has been brought to the rest of the world from here - sugarcane. We will wrap up this episode in the Moroccan province of Gulemin, a home to a nomadic tribe whose inseparable companions are camels.

programme.title: A Royal Recipe for Love
programme.desc: When Emma, a baker in NYC, is hired to bake for the King and Queen of Sanovia's anniversary party, she is convinced a good job will lead to her landing a cookbook deal.
